assets.name: presentPalm
assets.prompt: Edit INPUT1 George's existing forearm.png as a presentPalm FOREARM VARIANT. INPUT2 forearm_grip.png confirms same exact forearm anatomy/style/canvas. INPUT3 posed George screenshot is contextual ONLY to explain how this art is rotated by rig, DO NOT copy the pose into the sprite. Output exactly ONE isolated forearm with baked hand in the SAME LOCAL CANVAS ORIENTATION as input1: elbow at top, arm pointing down, hand at bottom. Canvas 426 x 439 pixels with same empty transparent margins, no tight crop or enlarged drawing. Preserve elbow cap and ALL forearm pixels above wrist IDENTICALLY, same outline silhouette, arm length, skin fill and shading. Wrist joint stays at original x=.5010*426 y=.5298*439 (approximately 213,233); elbow pivot at original y=.1559*439, preserve geometry. Change only wrist/hand below that point. Open hand with PALM turned UP AND OUT to audience when this downward-pointing forearm sprite is rotated onto the nearly horizontal forearm shown in the pose reference. Fingers together elegantly extending from wrist, thumb relaxed and separated, shallow cupped palm. Presentation: here I am / look at this. Hand can bend gently at wrist to expose palm, fingers not dangling limp, no fist. Match input1 restrained thin black ink contours, warm pale peach skin, broad simple soft muted shadow; no detailed muscle rendering or texture. Human hand with five anatomically coherent digits, proportional to existing hand, no extra fingers or jewelry. Original rounded elbow cap must remain smooth and UNOUTLINED at very top as source, not a black seam. Actual transparent background, fully opaque interiors, no shadow, no text/labels/grid/other body parts, no debris. Keep everything within full source canvas without cropping.
